name: Prismatic Rune

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Six charges (1d6 back at dawn): a charge turns a damaging spell to the rune's element (picked after a Long Rest).
text: When you finish a Long Rest you choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder for this rune. It has 6 charges and regains 1d6 expended charges each dawn. When you cast a spell that deals damage, you can spend 1 charge to change its damage to the chosen type. In a fight you ready it (no action) before the spell.

powers.name: Choose the Element
powers.text: After a Long Rest: the rune's element.

powers.name: Ready the Rune
powers.text: Your next damaging spell spends a charge and deals the rune's element instead.
